title: Marduk
summary: Marduk is a member of the Blood Spiral and serves as Kiel's tracker. Whereas Kiel brings the firepower, Marduk brings the stealth to their operations. His Blood Spiral mark is located on his right shoulder and is normally covered by his shirt, further assisting his going unnoticed.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Marduk was with Kiel when he burned down the house of Sophie and Lucas Casterwill, killing their parents. [The Spiral War]

Marduk rescued Kiel when he called for his Casterwill Hunters in Medusa's Cave and attempted to stop the Huntik Foundation team from retrieving Medusa's Amulet. [Zhalia's Mission]

Upon the Blood Spiral ascertaining the location of Focauld Casterwill, Marduk and Kiel went after Focauld's knowledge of the Casterwill family. The Huntik team, however, intervened and saved Focauld's Knowledgelock crystal from falling into the hands of the Spiral. [The Casterwill Connection]

Marduk later tried to stop Den Fears and Lok Lambert from activating the Blue Star while Kiel attempted to take on Dante Vale and Sophie Casterwill. Their attempts, however, failed. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Tantras asked him about the location of the Casterwills. [Sophie on Trial] Shortly thereafter, Marduk fought alongside the Blood Spiral in the assault on the Fortress of Iron Will. He gave chase to Santiago and fought with him, but later retreated when given the order by Tantras. [The Spiral War]

Marduk took the place of Kiel in the Blooded Circle, and spoke with Shauna, Wind, and Rassimov after the Huntik team retrieved Rassimov's secret files from his tenure within the Organization. [An Ally from the Organization]

With the longest night of the year nearly at hand, Marduk was commanded by Rassimov to stop the Huntik team, after receiving orders from the Betrayer himself. He tracked the Huntik team down to Nostradamus' Tomb and ambushed them, invoking his Psikofen and Helinx Titans. He then fought against Dante and Lok, but Lok was able to use the Willblade to defeat him. The Huntik team then teleported to the Spiral Mark using Umbra, leaving a seething Marduk behind. [Words from Eathon]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E49 Marduk 2.png|thumb]]
Marduk is an obedient follower. He is very observant and confident in his abilities. As a tracker, he also is calm and patient, as when one of the [[Casterwill Hunters]] told him to charge and destroy the Huntik team, Marduk ordered him to wait until they were in a corner so that they would be unable to escape. {{Source|Words from Eathon}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E37_Marduk_invokes_Cerberus.png|thumb|Marduk invokes [[Cerberus]]]]
As Kiel's chief tracker, Marduk possesses outstanding tracking and agility abilities, being able to locate his targets with ease. His tracking abilities even permit him to seek out people who are in hiding, as when he tracked down the whereabouts of [[Focauld Casterwill]]. {{Source|The Casterwill Connection}} As a Seeker, most of his abilities revolve around tracking and pyrotechnics, while the majority of his Titans are based on animals. He commonly uses his [[Midnight Rook]] Titan to locate his targets and his [[Cerberus]] Titan to attack his enemies.

sections.wikitext:
* Marduk's name comes from the Mesopotamian god, [[wikipedia:Marduk|Marduk]], known variably as the patron god of Babylon, a storm god, and the king of the Babylonian pantheon of gods.
* Marduk's [[Titans]] (aside from [[Psikofen]]) are all based on animals, a nod to his profession as a tracker.
*Marduk's appearance strongly resembles [[Hector]], an [[Organization]] tomb raider who appears in [[TCG:SAS-034|SAS-034]].
